what: Binary distribution plan: compile all hook logic into aide-memory binary via bun compile. Bash hooks become 2-line thin wrappers (cat | aide-memory hook pre-read). All logic private: blocking decisions, scope depth, dynamic intervals, correction detection, config reading, pro gating, tracking management. Visible: only hook names and that they call the binary. Implementation: after current defaults optimization, migrate hook logic from bash to TypeScript, compile to binary. Same codebase, different build target.
why: User wants closed-source distribution. Hooks are the weak point — always readable bash. Moving logic to binary solves visibility for both code protection and settings enforcement.
